acceptanceCriteria: `deleted` and `not-observed` verification states are specified, decoded strictly and covered by compose tests.
body:
Filed from the audit of https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/64 (generic ExternalEvidenceProvider contract) on 2026-09-22.

`internal/extevidence/compose.go:11-15` enumerates the verification constants. A referenced path or line that existed at the provider revision but is deleted at the target, and a reference the provider never observed, both need their own verification state so the consumer never reports invented certainty (AGENTS.md invariant 2).
title: extevidence: reference verification lacks `deleted` and `not-observed` states
